mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; amphotericin B may increase valacyclovir levels by reducing renal clearance, elevating risk of neurotoxicity and crystalline nephropathy.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and BUN closely; adjust valacyclovir dosing based on renal function; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for neurological symptoms.
